scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Hm, I'm sorry if I made
a big scene when you grazed
me with that attack accidentally. It's just that I was training so
diligently and blood sugar was incredibly low and the fatigue...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
嗯，刚才你不小心擦伤了我，我反应是有点大，抱歉。
都怪练得太拼，血糖低得厉害，再加上累...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hah! Admit it,
old man! You were
just scared! Me, on
the other hand...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哈！承认吧，老头！
你就是吓着了！
换成我嘛...

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
You little
whippersnapper!
I don't know what
you're talking about!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
你这小鬼头！
我不知道你在说什么！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
I recognize you
from somewhere,
I think. Reidin, do you
remember this guy?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
我觉得我好像在哪里见过你。
雷丁，你记得这家伙吗？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Oh come on, we see
hundreds of Archers and
Hunters and Snipers and...
I can't remember them all.
But I guess this guy's up
to snuff. Trust me on this!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
拜托，我们见过多少弓箭手、猎人、神射手...哪记得过来。
不过，这家伙肯定够格，信我的！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Alright, alright.
If Reidin thinks you're
worthy, then you're probably
are. In that case, I'd like to
offer to teach you my secret
skill, ''Phantasmic Arrow.''
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
好好好，雷丁说你行，那应该就没错。
既然如此，我就传授你独门绝技：幻影箭。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Wait, wait. This guy
only needs a refresher.
Yeah, I'm pretty sure you
were here to learn this
skill before. Yeah, I've
got a gut feeling about it.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
等等，人家只是来温习的。
对，我敢肯定，你以前来学过这招。
嗯，直觉告诉我的。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Damn. Only a refresher?
That means you'll learn
this free of charge. Alright...
You should be able to use the
Phantasmic Arrow skill now.
Travel safely now, you hear?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
啧，只是温习？
那就没法收钱了。
好吧...现在应该能用幻影箭了。
路上小心，听见没？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Hm? You're back?
Oh, did you bring
everything? Ah, you did.
Good! Now I shall reveal
my super secret skill...
The 1st Arpesto Form!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
嗯？回来了？
东西都带齐了？
啊，齐了，很好！
接下来就让你见识我的超级绝技...阿尔佩斯托第一式！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Wait! Wait...
Didn't you call it
Arpesto's 3rd Form
or something at first?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
等等！等等...
你刚才不是叫它阿尔佩斯托第三式之类的吗？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Er, yes, Arpesto's
3rd Form, that's right.
It's just there's just so
many of them, that... 
Anyway, let me teach you
the ''Emergency Arrow'' skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
呃，对，阿尔佩斯托第三式，没错。
招式太多，难免...总之，我来教你“紧急箭”。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Whoa, hold on!
''Emergency Arrow?!''
That's the old name you
gave that skill, right?
Didn't you change it?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哇，等一下！
“紧急箭”？！
那是你以前给那个技能起的名字，对吧？
你不是改过名字吗？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
What the hell
are you talkin--
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
你到底胡说什——

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Oh, you're right.
We agreed that name
was too cheesy. What
did we call it now? Um...
''Phantasmic Arrow?''
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
哦，对，我们说好那名字太土了。
现在叫什么来着？
嗯...“幻影箭”？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Umm....
Ummm........
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯...
嗯嗯...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Yeah, that was the one!
''^3131FFPhantasmic Arrow^000000'' sounds
soooo much cooler than that
other name you came up with!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
没错，就是那个！
“^3131FF幻影箭^000000”听起来比你之前想的那个名字酷多了！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
You can be pretty handy
sometimes, Reidin. Now,
back to the matter at hand.
I shall teach you my awesome
skill, Phantasmic Arrow. Now...
Ready your mind and body!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
雷丁，偶尔你还挺管用。
好了，说正事。
我要传授你我的拿手绝技，幻影箭。
现在...凝神，做好准备！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Phan-!
Ta-!
Ssssss-!
Mic-!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
Phan-!
Ta-!
Ssssss-!
Mic-!

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
ARRRRRRRROOOOOOW~!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
ARRRRRRRROOOOOOW~!

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
^333333*Pant Pant*^000000
Alright, I used a special
technique to teach you the
skill-- directly into your brain. You should be able to use it
now. Why don't give it a try?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
^333333*呼哧呼哧*^000000
好了，我用特殊手法，直接把招式灌进了你的脑子。
现在应该会用了，试试看？

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Swwwwwww!*
*Bang!*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*Swwwwwww!*
*Bang!*^000000

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
^333333*Pant Pant*
*Cough Cough*
*Cough Cough*^000000

[Arpesto]
WHHHHHHHY MEEEEE?!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
为什...为什么是我？！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ar-Arpesto, no!
...........................
Oh. Oh, come on! The arrow
just glanced you! You'll be
alright. Quit being a baby.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
阿、阿尔佩斯托，不！
...
哦，拜托！箭就擦了一下！
没事的，别像小孩子一样大惊小怪。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Eh, don't worry about
Arpesto. He's just being
a crazy old man. I'll take
care of him, so just make
sure you make good use
of that new skill. Take care~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
别担心阿尔佩斯托，他这疯老头就这样。
我会照顾他的，你好好运用新招就行。
保重~

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Hurry up and bring
^3131FF5 Cursed Rubies^000000,
^3131FF30 Pet Foods^000000 and
^3131FF5 Harpy Feathers^000000.
Then, I can teach you
the Emergency Arrow skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
快带来这些东西：
^3131FF诅咒红宝石5颗^000000
^3131FF宠物饲料30份^000000
^3131FF哈比的羽毛5根^000000
带齐了，我就教你紧急箭。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Ah, very nice.
Um, as you demonstrated
earlier, my teaching technique
was perfect. But next time, use
the skill on foes that deserve
to be beaten, alright? Good.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
嗯，很好。
刚才你也证明了，我教得无可挑剔。
不过下次要拿这招对付该打的敌人，明白吗？
很好。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Did the master send you
to me? Hmm... You're still
pretty green from the looks
of it. Yeah, I don't think there's anything I can teach quite yet.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
是师父叫你来的？
嗯...看着还嫩了点，暂时没什么能教你的。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Train a little more and get
some more experience in
your job. When you become
more adept at hunting, you'll
be able to grasp what I've been
teaching Hunters and Snipers.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
再练练，多积累些职业经验。
等狩猎本领长进了，就能领会我传授给猎人和神射手的招式。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Has the master sent you?
Ah, you definitely have the
keen, vulture like eyes of a
true Hunter. You should be
capable of learning my secret
skill, the 3rd Arpesto Form...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
师父叫你来的？
嗯，目光锐利如秃鹫，确实是个真正的猎人。
看来足以学习我的独门绝技，阿尔佩斯托第三式...

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
It's a handy skill that
I developed while battling
Medusas and running out
of arrows. I simply call it,
''^3131FFEmergency Arrow^000000.'' Would you
be interested in learning it?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
这招很实用，是我和米杜沙交战、箭又用光时创出来的。
名字很简单，就叫“^3131FF紧急箭^000000”。
想学吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please!
scripts.translation: 请教我

scripts.text: Ummm...

[Arpesto]
Great, great. Of course,
you can't resist this offer
if you recognize this skill's
value. However, I'd like to
ask for a little tuition in return for me teaching this to you.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
好，好，识货的人当然舍不得错过。
不过，教你这招，得收一点学费。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Although I feel guilt at
asking for payment from
a fellow Hunter, creating
this skill required much
sacrifice and unimaginable
bloodshed on my part...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
向同为猎人的你收费，我是有些过意不去。
可为了创出这招，我付出了莫大的牺牲，不知流了多少血...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey! You liar!
I was there when you
accidently made up that
skill when you were bored
and just messing around
with one of the Bows!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
喂，骗子！
你明明是无聊了，随便摆弄一把弓，误打误撞创出来的，我当时就在旁边！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
^333333*Ahem*^000000 Please Reidin,
don't entertain unfounded
rumors. It was only after
countless battles with Eddga
that I managed to invent and
perfect Emergency Arrow.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
^333333*咳咳*^000000雷丁，别信那些没根据的谣言。
我可是与虎王交手无数次，才创出并完善了紧急箭。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
^333333*Tsk tsk*^000000 Huh.
I thought you said
you developed it while
you were fighting Medusas.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
^333333*啧啧*^000000哼，你刚才不是说，和米杜沙打架时创出来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
A-anyway, please bring
me the following items
as tuition in exchange for
me teaching you this skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
总、总之，要学这招，先把下面这些东西带来，作为学费。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Please bring me
^3131FF5 Cursed Rubies^000000,
^3131FF30 Pet Foods^000000 and
^3131FF5 Harpy Feathers^000000.
Then I can teach
you this skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
请带来：
^3131FF诅咒红宝石5颗^000000
^3131FF宠物饲料30份^000000
^3131FF哈比的羽毛5根^000000
然后我就教你。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
30 Pet Foods?
What the heck do
you need all that for?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
30份宠物饲料？
你要那么多干什么？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
I...
I'm going to
use it to feed
my pet Falcon.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
我...我要拿来喂我的宠物猎鹰。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
...
......
.........
......Riiiight.

[Arpesto]
Alright, it's your
decision. However, I'm
sure that you may have
great need of my skill
sooner or later, so return
to me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
行，你自己决定。
不过，迟早有用得上这招的时候，改变主意了就来找我。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
The sky still looks clear, but recently the winds that have been blowing through the land seem to carry with them an air of misfortune.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
天空看起来依然晴朗，但最近吹过这片土地的风，似乎带着不祥的气息。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
So...
Danger's coming?
Heh! Chill, gramps~
I got it covered!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
所以...危险快来了？
嘿，放心吧，老爷子~
有我呢！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Ho ho...
Energetic, but
cocky. Kids nowadays...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
呵呵...有朝气，就是太自负。
现在的年轻人啊...
